snippet.title: Adventure Llama | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Other Llamas spit at people and eat grass all day. But Pablo is different: He explores ancient ruins built by the Inca Llamas of the past! 🦙

Running madly inside the temple, Pablo will find the truth about the native Llamas of a lost time - and get lots of shiny gold artifacts! 💎 Finish levels to get Llama-moneys - then use them to unlock new worlds or get loads of cool costumes! 🎉

Adventure Llama is out for PC on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Google Play and App Store.
